title: Tier 0u Self-Consistency Logical Inconsistency Verifier
honest_verdict: complete: Tier0uVerifier implemented; AUROC=0.96 on n=100 synthetic corpus; viable=true
methodology_note: Three self-inconsistency signals: (1) explicit self-correction phrases ('actually', 'wait', 'I made an error', 'let me redo', etc.) weighted 0.4 per occurrence; (2) contradiction markers ('but', 'however', 'yet') within 60-character window of a numeric literal, weighted 0.2 per occurrence; (3) final-answer-vs-last-intermediate mismatch (regex detects 'The answer is X' / 'Therefore X' patterns, compares X to the last number in the reasoning body), weighted 0.5. Score is normalised by (n_numerical_claim_sentences + 1) to penalise density not length. All pattern matching via compiled Python regex; no LLM call required. Corpus: 50 consistent arithmetic templates and 50 inconsistent templates (containing self-corrections or final-answer mismatches) generated with random.seed(42). Based on arXiv:2605.03971 self-consistency constraint approach.
